name: When should I consider upgrading my garage entry for accessibility?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading my garage entry for accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading your garage entry for accessibility if you or a family member experience mobility challenges, use a wheelchair, walker, or cane, or if you anticipate aging in place. It's also beneficial if you want to improve general safety and convenience for all users. Proactive upgrades can prevent accidents and significantly enhance the daily living experience, making your home more inclusive and functional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider upgrading if you or a family member has mobility challenges, uses mobility aids, plan to age in place, or want to improve overall safety and convenience.
